bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; hbfd_pad_r17x115 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/die_glue/hbfd_pad.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hbfd_pad_r17x115/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hbfd_pad_r17x115/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hbfd_pad_r17x115 --out {RUN}/record/views/hbfd_pad_r17x115  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

Successor of codex 0c3eecf04/366dc27e7 whose 8 ingress copies were aliased by Yosys to 17 Q x 115 loads: copies are now keep_hierarchy hbfd_pad_icopy instances (8 x 17 b, <=16 row loads each); reset lands in 2 registered stages (rs_s1 + 4 kept hbfd_pad_rst_land copies, <=16 loads), the 2 landing edges paid by 2 face data stages so the total stays exactly 115 edges, II1.
